title: 第二章 我的宝贝修女第三章 神恩赐福
lines: 森林里古树虬结，枝蔓遍地，唯有一条泥泞的羊肠小道蜿蜒着通向森林深处。零星的阳光透过浓密的树冠层洒落，驱散了树林里的昏暗，为这唯一的小道添上了一抹亮色。
此刻，小道上，有一个白衣少女正在狼狈奔跑着。
昨天刚下了一场雨，本就狭窄的小道变得异常泥泞，她跑得跌跌撞撞，一身代表圣洁的白色修女服上沾满了泥垢，就连脚下的靴子也已经跑丢了一只，却依旧难掩那姣好的身段和一身纯净无垢的气息。
因为脱力，她脸色一片惨白，却依旧紧紧捏着用长链挂在脖子上的银色十字架，声音发颤地祈祷：“仁慈而伟大的光明神啊，请您降下神恩，救救我们吧~”
“凯瑟琳娜，快！快跑！”一个年轻的战士猛地从后窜上来，拉着她就向前飞奔，惨白的脸上神色悲愤，“那个狗屁光明神早就挂了，你再祈祷有什么用？”
他看上去不过十八九岁，手里倒提着一把精钢长剑，身上穿着制作精良的皮甲，衬着那魁梧的身形，看起来战力不俗。
可惜，他后背已经中了一箭，箭羽随着奔跑轻颤。而他的腹部更是豁开了条口子，仅仅来得及用布缠了以下，伤口不断有鲜血渗出，触目惊心。
两人身后，几个手持长枪或弓箭的士兵正快步追来。
这些士兵穿着结实皮甲，手里的武器泛着寒光，看向两人的目光就像是在看待宰的羔羊，泛着狰狞的凶光。
他们在泥泞的小道上健步如飞，没过一会就越追越近。
“伟大的光明神啊，请您降下神恩，救救我们吧~”白衣少女眼心中绝望，却依旧不肯死心，喘息着低声祈祷。
时至今日，她其实对光明神是否还活着已经不抱什么希望，只是如今穷途末路，这是她唯一能抓住的一根救命稻草。
可惜，和以往的每一次一样，她的祈祷没有得到任何回应。
她湛蓝的眼眸中划过一抹绝望。
难道，光明神真的已经陨落吗？难道，他们今天真的注定要死在这里吗？
蓦地。
凯瑟琳娜脚底一滑，猛地摔了个跟头。
这一下摔得极重，她整个人都重重地砸在了地上，连着打了两个滚才撞到旁边的树根停了下来，疼得她浑身打颤，连站都站不起来。
“糟了！”
年轻战士登时脸色大变。
他连忙伸手拉住凯瑟琳娜，费力地把她架起来，想要带着她继续跑。
然而，即便他反应已经很快，却依旧晚了一步。就这么一晃眼的功夫，那几个士兵已经快步追了上来，如狼似虎地把他们围在了中间。
他们都是隶属于男爵刚德亚尔的直属私兵。
“哈哈哈~小妞，你不是挺能跑吗？继续跑啊~”
为首的络腮胡子发出一声**怪调地大笑，提着杆寒光锃亮的长枪一步步朝两人逼近。那长枪上，还沾着猩红血水，刺的人心头发寒。
“滚开！”
年轻战士心中一紧，当即一把拉住凯瑟琳娜把她护在了身后，横剑怒目，朝那络腮胡子低吼：“凯瑟琳娜是修女，是光明神的仆人，你们胆敢渎神！”
虽然他已经不再信仰光明神，可这种时候，他也顾不得这么多了，决定先扯个虎皮再说。
“渎神？”络腮胡子愣了一下，随即像是听到了什么笑话一般，嚣张狂笑，“蠢货！陛下已经公开宣布光明神陨落，取缔剿灭光明教廷的公函早已经发布全国。你现在还敢信奉狗屁光明神，真是可笑。”
“不可能，卢克神甫一年多前还聆听过光明神旨意！”凯瑟琳娜脸色惨白，彷如被逼到绝境的母狮般奋力挣扎，声音悲愤，“伟大的光明吾主，怎么可能陨落？！”
一年多前，正是吴辉还没继承光明神神位之时。
“卢克神甫？”络腮胡子一声怪笑，“你说的是那个胆敢去圣城宣扬异端邪说的疯子？哈哈哈，如果光明神真还活着，半年前那疯子在圣城广场被裁决的时候，祂怎么没展现神迹？”
凯瑟琳娜闻言脸色更白，眼泪控制不住地从眼角滚落。
content_en:
…
The ancient trees in the forest were gnarled and branches spread all over the place. There was only a muddy winding path leading deep into the forest. Scattered sunlight shines through the dense canopy of trees, dispersing the darkness in the woods and adding a touch of bright color to this only trail.
At this moment, on the trail, a girl in white was running in embarrassment.
It had just rained yesterday, and the already narrow path became extremely muddy. She was stumbling while running, and her white nun's uniform, which represented holiness, was covered in mud. Even one of her boots had been lost, but she still couldn't conceal her beautiful figure and pure aura.
Due to the loss of strength, her face turned pale, but she still held tightly the silver cross hung on a long chain around her neck and prayed with a trembling voice: "O kind and great God of Light, please send down your grace and save us~"
"Catherina, hurry! Run!" A young warrior suddenly rushed up from behind, pulled her and flew forward, with a look of grief and anger on his pale face, "That bullshit god of light has died a long time ago, what's the use of praying anymore?"
He looked to be only eighteen or nineteen years old. He was holding a fine steel sword in his hand, and he was wearing well-made leather armor. With his burly figure, he looked quite capable in battle.
Unfortunately, he had already been hit by an arrow in the back, and the arrow feathers trembled slightly as he ran. There was even a gash in his abdomen, and he only had time to wrap the lower part with cloth. Blood continued to seep out of the wound, which was shocking.
Behind the two men, several soldiers armed with spears or bows and arrows were chasing after them quickly.
These soldiers were wearing strong leather armor, and the weapons in their hands glowed with cold light. They looked at the two men like they were looking at slaughtered lambs, with a ferocious glare.
They walked quickly on the muddy path, and after a while they were getting closer and closer.
"Great God of Light, please show us your grace and save us~" The girl in white had despair in her eyes, but still refused to give up. She breathed and prayed in a low voice.
To this day, she actually has no hope that the God of Light is still alive, but now that she is at the end of her rope, this is the only life-saving straw she can grasp.
Unfortunately, like every time before, her prayers went unanswered.
There was a flash of despair in her blue eyes.
Could it be that the God of Light has really fallen? Are they really destined to die here today?
Suddenly.
The sole of Katharina's foot slipped and she fell suddenly.
The fall was so heavy that her whole body hit the ground hard, and she rolled twice before hitting a tree root next to her and stopping. The pain made her tremble all over and she couldn't even stand up.
"Oops!"
The young soldier's expression suddenly changed.
He quickly reached out to grab Katherina, struggled to lift her up, and wanted to continue running with her.
However, even though he reacted quickly, he was still a step late. In just a blink of an eye, the soldiers had already caught up with them and surrounded them like wolves and tigers.
They are all private soldiers directly affiliated with Baron Gundyard.
"Hahaha~ Girl, aren't you pretty good at running? Keep running~"
The bearded leader let out a weird laugh and approached the two of them step by step with a spear that shone brightly in the cold light. The spear was still stained with scarlet blood, and it stung people's hearts with chills.
"Get away!"
The young warrior's heart tightened, and he immediately grabbed Katherina and protected her behind him. Heng Jian glared angrily and growled at the bearded man: "Catherina is a nun and a servant of the God of Light. How dare you blaspheme!"
Although he no longer believed in the God of Light, at this time, he didn't care so much anymore and decided to talk about it first.
"Blasphemy?" The bearded man was stunned for a moment, and then he laughed arrogantly as if he had heard some joke, "Idiot! Your Majesty has publicly announced the fall of the God of Light, and the official letter to ban the annihilation of the Holy See of Light has been issued to the whole country. You still dare to believe in the bullshit God of Light now, it is really ridiculous."
"Impossible, Father Luke listened to the will of the God of Light more than a year ago!" Katherina's face turned pale, struggling like a lioness forced into a desperate situation, her voice was filled with grief and anger, "How could it be possible for our great Lord of Light to fall?!"
More than a year ago, it was before Wu Hui inherited the throne of the God of Light.
"Father Luke?" The bearded man laughed strangely, "Are you talking about the madman who dared to go to the Holy City to preach heresy? Hahaha, if the God of Light is really still alive, why didn't He show any miracles when the madman was sentenced in the Holy City Square half a year ago?"
Katharina's face turned even paler when she heard this, and tears rolled down from the corners of her eyes uncontrollably.
